parts.text: Which claim correctly limits what the display allows him to conclude?

options.text: Among the $32$ surveyed students in Class 8C in 2025, mathematics was chosen most often; the chart does not show every class in the school.
The tallest bar proves why those students prefer mathematics.
Cricket must also be the favourite because the tallest bar always names a sport.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

stem: Kabir reads a bar chart titled "Favourite subject in Class 8C, 2025 school survey of $32$ students." Mathematics has the tallest bar.

part_answers.answer: The title states the source, year, class, and sample size, so conclusions stay inside that survey; causes and other classes are not measured.

teacher.key_rationale: Scope is the stated Class 8C 2025 survey of 32 students; no causal claim or other classes.
